welcome.ageDeclaration: I declare that I am 18 years of age or older and agree to guided acoustic wellness practice.
welcome.privacyNote: Your voice audio stays 100% private in your browser. We never record or transmit your speech.

calibrate.title: Step 1: Noise Floor Calibration
calibrate.instruction: Please stay silent for 3 seconds while we calibrate your room's background acoustic level.
calibrate.noiseWarning: Room is slightly noisy. For best results, use headphones or move to a quieter space.

sing.title: Step 2: Voice Scale Detection
sing.instruction: Sing any familiar song or chant naturally for 15 seconds to let the model capture your voice's natural pitch and resonance.
sing.saHoldPrompt: Hold the note 'Sa' (Aaah...) steadily for 4 seconds to calibrate your natural scale.

scaleResult.title: Step 3: Your Natural Scale
scaleResult.manualPrompt: If this does not feel like your comfortable root pitch, select your preferred scale below:

listen.title: Step 4: Listen to Reference Mantra
listen.playingMsg: 🎵 Playing gapless reference audio... Listen closely to pitch and tone.
listen.idleMsg: Click to listen to the mantra audio loop.
listen.halfDuplex: 🔒 Half-duplex Safety: Microphone is stopped during playback to eliminate speaker feedback.

chantEval.title: Step 5: Practice & Evaluation
chantEval.instruction: Chant the seed mantra "{mantra}" on Swara {swar} ({targetHz} Hz). Achieve ≥ {passAcc}% accuracy over {voicedSec}s of singing.

chantHold.title: Step 6: Sustained Chanting Hold
chantHold.instruction: Maintain your resonance for 10 minutes. Aim for at least 50% active voiced chanting time.

sessionDone.title: Session Completed!
sessionDone.celebration: Wonderful resonance! You have completed Day {day} of your 45-day journey.
